# AI for Finance

**Machine learning for markets and money: how quant firms work, portfolios and factors, honest backtesting, financial text, credit risk, and LLMs in finance. Education, not investment advice.**

Level: **Intermediate** · 11 steps · 8h 26m of video · Prerequisites: [Machine Learning](machine-learning.md) and [Python & Math for AI](foundations.md). [Time Series & Forecasting](time-series-and-forecasting.md) helps.

[Track your progress on the website](https://gruheshkurra.github.io/awesome-ai-roadmaps/ai-for-finance/) · [All roadmaps](../README.md)

## Build it

- Backtest a moving-average crossover with backtesting.py, then run a permutation test on permuted price changes to see if it beats chance.
- Score a month of financial headlines with FinBERT and plot daily sentiment next to the stock's daily returns.
- Train a credit-risk classifier on the German credit data, report precision and recall, and explain it with SHAP.
